source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第三节

textbook_summary: P duration is at least 120 ms.
Separation between P-wave peaks is at least 40 ms.
P-wave notching is prominent in leads I, II, aVL.
The ratio of P duration to PR-segment duration is greater than 1.6.
The magnitude of terminal P force in V1 is at least 0.04 mm*s at 10 mm/mV.
scope: An abnormal left-atrial P-wave teaching example, not a specific diagnosis of left atrial enlargement or a realistic atrial model.

authored_choices.kernel: Existing rounded PWaveComponentsIllustrationDraft@1; no new LUT
notes: Values are authored illustration choices, not textbook patient measurements. Opposite RA/LA and zero LL retain zero Wilson P exactly. RL is not used in lead projection. PR, QRS, ST, T and U remain caller-owned. Initial PR constraint is not a measured PR in AV dissociation.

verification: Projected 250Hz samples: P span, two-peak separation, V1 positive onset and terminal depth*duration; exact Einthoven relation; ventricular parity; checkpoint bytes; native pixels and atomic application
limitations: Windows visual behavior is not yet manually verified
